accepted.s: Visakhapatnam Port was opened to ocean traffic in which year?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam Port was opened to ocean traffic in 1933.
accepted.tq: Use the direct year-recall method for an opening-history fact.
accepted.sec: Visakhapatnam Port - opening history, harbour type, depth and traffic rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Visakhapatnam Port:
1. It has both natural and artificial harbour features.
2. Its outer harbour serves iron ore exports.
3. It has a crude oil berth.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Visakhapatnam has natural and artificial harbour components, an outer harbour for iron ore exports and a crude oil berth.
accepted.tq: Test a cluster of related port functions through coded statements.
accepted.sec: Visakhapatnam Port - opening history, harbour type, depth and traffic rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Visakhapatnam Port is popularly known by which of the following names?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam Port is called the “Brightest Jewel”.
accepted.tq: Use an exact sobriquet-recall question with closely related maritime distractors.
accepted.sec: Visakhapatnam Port - opening history, harbour type, depth and traffic rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The natural protection to Visakhapatnam harbour is provided by which geographical feature?
o: Dolphin's Nose on the Yarada hills
accepted.x: Dolphin's Nose on the Yarada hills gives natural protection to Visakhapatnam harbour.
accepted.tq: Apply the location-feature association method.
accepted.sec: Visakhapatnam Port - opening history, harbour type, depth and traffic rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In 2025–26, Visakhapatnam Port recorded traffic of approximately:
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam Port recorded 91.17 million metric tonnes in 2025–26.
accepted.tq: Separate the exact quantitative figure from nearby numerical distractors.
accepted.sec: Visakhapatnam Port - opening history, harbour type, depth and traffic rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The traffic handled by Visakhapatnam Port in 2025–26 increased by approximately:
accepted.x: The port recorded a 10.34 per cent increase in traffic in 2025–26.
accepted.tq: Test the percentage separately from the associated absolute traffic figure.
accepted.sec: Visakhapatnam Port - opening history, harbour type, depth and traffic rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding Visakhapatnam Port's seafood traffic is correct?
o: It handled more than half of India's seafood exports in FY 2025–26.
It handled 19.32 lakh tonnes of seafood exports in FY 2025–26.
It is India's top seafood-export port and handled 5.12 lakh tonnes in FY 2025–26.
It is India's top seafood-import port and handled 2.15 lakh tonnes in FY 2025–26.
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam is India's top seafood-export port and handled 5.12 lakh tonnes in FY 2025–26, over 26 per cent of India's 19.32 lakh tonnes.
accepted.tq: Compare the port's share and absolute quantity without reversing export and import.
accepted.sec: Visakhapatnam Port - opening history, harbour type, depth and traffic rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which certification is held by Vijayawada railway station?
o: LEED Gold certification by the USA
accepted.x: Vijayawada railway station holds an IGBC Platinum green certification.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the correct certifying body and a look-alike certification.
accepted.sec: Railway stations and trains of AP - green certification, tourist trains (Araku)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Vijayawada railway station:
1. It has building-integrated rooftop solar panels.
2. Its green certification is issued by IGBC.
3. Its certification is a LEED, USA, Platinum certification.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The station has rooftop solar panels and IGBC Platinum certification; the LEED, USA description is incorrect.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong certifying authority in a statement-based question.
accepted.sec: Railway stations and trains of AP - green certification, tourist trains (Araku)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: How many net-zero railway stations were declared by the Vijayawada division of South Central Railway?
accepted.x: The Vijayawada division declared ten net-zero stations, including Dwarapudi and Kadiyam.
accepted.tq: Test the exact count and use named examples as confirmation.
accepted.sec: Railway stations and trains of AP - green certification, tourist trains (Araku)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Dwarapudi and Kadiyam, mentioned in relation to the Vijayawada railway division, are:
accepted.x: Dwarapudi and Kadiyam are among the ten net-zero stations declared by the Vijayawada division.
accepted.tq: Match named places with their specific railway initiative.
accepted.sec: Railway stations and trains of AP - green certification, tourist trains (Araku)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which railway station near Sriharikota was redeveloped under the Amrit Bharat scheme?
accepted.x: Sullurupeta, near Sriharikota, was redeveloped under the Amrit Bharat scheme.
accepted.tq: Use the location clue to identify the station linked with the scheme.
accepted.sec: Railway stations and trains of AP - green certification, tourist trains (Araku)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Araku railway line forms part of which railway line?
accepted.x: The Araku line is part of the Kottavalasa–Kirandul line.
accepted.tq: Test the parent railway line of a tourist route.
accepted.sec: Railway stations and trains of AP - green certification, tourist trains (Araku)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The glass-roofed coaches operating on the Visakhapatnam–Araku route are known as:
accepted.x: Glass-roofed Vistadome coaches operate on the Visakhapatnam–Araku route.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact official term rather than a descriptive synonym.
accepted.sec: Railway stations and trains of AP - green certification, tourist trains (Araku)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding National Waterway 4:
1. It passes through Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Puducherry.
2. It includes the Godavari and Krishna river stretches.
3. It includes the Kakinada, Eluru, Commamur and Buckingham canals.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. NW-4 passes through the four mentioned regions and includes the stated rivers and canals.
accepted.tq: Combine route, river and canal components in a comprehensive coded question.
accepted.sec: Inland waterways and riverine projects in AP (NW-4, Buckingham Canal) [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the river stretches included in National Waterway 4?
accepted.x: The specified NW-4 river stretches are the Godavari from Bhadrachalam to Dowleswaram and the Krishna from Wazirabad to Prakasam Barrage.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure river-stretch pair to eliminate the other combinations.
accepted.sec: Inland waterways and riverine projects in AP (NW-4, Buckingham Canal) [APPSC]

accepted.s: The total length of National Waterway 4 is approximately:
accepted.x: National Waterway 4 is approximately 1,095 km long.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the total length of NW-4 from the separate length of Buckingham Canal.
accepted.sec: Inland waterways and riverine projects in AP (NW-4, Buckingham Canal) [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Buckingham Canal is approximately how long?
accepted.x: The Buckingham Canal is about 796 km long.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact quantitative feature of a named canal.
accepted.sec: Inland waterways and riverine projects in AP (NW-4, Buckingham Canal) [APPSC]

accepted.s: The hydrographic surveys completed by the Inland Waterways Authority of India in March 2026 related to which river stretch?
accepted.x: IWAI completed hydrographic surveys of the Krishna stretch in March 2026.
accepted.tq: Associate the dated technical activity with the correct river.
accepted.sec: Inland waterways and riverine projects in AP (NW-4, Buckingham Canal) [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Industrial Policy 2024–29 of Andhra Pradesh proposes development of NW-4 primarily to:
o: Close the Buckingham Canal to navigation
Cut freight costs through a modal shift
Replace all railway freight with air cargo
accepted.x: The policy relies on development of NW-4 to reduce freight costs through a modal shift toward inland waterways.
accepted.tq: Apply the stated policy objective to a transport-planning scenario.
accepted.sec: Inland waterways and riverine projects in AP (NW-4, Buckingham Canal) [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the correct category of Bhogapuram Airport?
accepted.x: Bhogapuram, officially Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport, is a greenfield international airport.
accepted.tq: Distinguish airport category from ownership and operational status.

accepted.s: Bhogapuram Airport is being developed under which arrangement?
o: GMR-led PPP through GVIAL under DBFOT
Government department construction without private participation
accepted.x: Bhogapuram Airport is being developed by GMR through GVIAL under the PPP-DBFOT model.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct implementing agency and project model.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the capacity and estimated cost of Bhogapuram Airport?
accepted.x: Bhogapuram Airport has a stated capacity of 6 million passengers per annum and an estimated cost of ₹5,640 crore.
accepted.tq: Match two quantitative attributes of the same infrastructure project.

accepted.s: Which sequence regarding Bhogapuram Airport is correct?
o: Validation flight—4 January 2026; inauguration—1 August 2026; commercial flights—17 August 2026
Validation flight—1 August 2026; inauguration—4 January 2026; commercial flights—17 August 2026
Validation flight—17 August 2026; inauguration—1 August 2026; commercial flights—4 January 2026
Validation flight—4 January 2025; inauguration—17 August 2025; commercial flights—1 August 2026
accepted.x: The validation flight occurred on 4 January 2026, the Prime Minister was scheduled to inaugurate it on 1 August 2026, and commercial flights were scheduled from 17 August 2026.
accepted.tq: Arrange dated project milestones from the earliest to the latest.

accepted.s: Bhogapuram Airport is officially named:
accepted.x: Bhogapuram Airport is named Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport.
accepted.tq: Test the exact official name against other Andhra-associated personalities.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about Visakhapatnam Airport after August 2026 is correct?
o: It became a domestic-only airport after Bhogapuram opened.
Scheduled flights moved to Bhogapuram, while Visakhapatnam Airport remains an international civil enclave at INS Dega.
It was permanently closed and converted into a railway terminal.
It became a private airstrip without international status.
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam Airport is an international civil enclave at INS Dega, and scheduled flights moved to Bhogapuram in August 2026.
accepted.tq: Separate a change in scheduled operations from a change in airport category.

accepted.s: Which pair of airports in Andhra Pradesh is correctly classified as international?
accepted.x: Vijayawada (Gannavaram) and Tirupati (Renigunta) are classified as international airports.
accepted.tq: Start with the pair having the same airport category.

accepted.s: Tirupati Airport has been classified as an international airport since:
accepted.x: Tirupati Airport has held international status since October 2015.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the airport-status date from the opening dates of other airports.

accepted.s: Which airport has a 3,810-metre runway suitable for Code 4E aircraft?
accepted.x: Tirupati Airport has a 3,810-metre runway capable of handling Code 4E aircraft.
accepted.tq: Match the runway specification with the correct airport.

accepted.s:
Which of the following airports are classified as domestic airports in Andhra Pradesh?
1. Rajahmundry
2. Kadapa
3. Orvakal
4. Tirupati
Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
accepted.x: Rajahmundry, Kadapa and Orvakal are domestic airports. Tirupati is classified as an international airport.
accepted.tq: Classify several airports and eliminate the one with a different status.

accepted.s: Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy Airport is another name for:
accepted.x: Orvakal Airport in Kurnool is officially known as Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy Airport.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between an airport's location name and its official name.

accepted.s: Kadapa Airport was opened on:
accepted.x: Kadapa Airport was opened on 7 June 2015.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact opening date and distinguish it from Orvakal's operational date.

accepted.s: Orvakal Airport became operational on:
accepted.x: Orvakal Airport became operational on 25 March 2021.
accepted.tq: Use date discrimination among multiple airport milestones.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes Dagadarthi Airport?
o: An operational international airport with a naval enclave
A private airstrip operated by the Sri Sathya Sai Trust
A proposed no-frills greenfield airport with a cargo hub
accepted.x: Dagadarthi in Nellore is a proposed no-frills greenfield airport under PPP, planned with a cargo hub.
accepted.tq: Separate proposed, operational and private-airstrip categories.

accepted.s: The estimated cost of the proposed Dagadarthi Airport is:
accepted.x: The estimated cost of Dagadarthi Airport is ₹1,499.17 crore.
accepted.tq: Match the exact project cost with the correct airport.

accepted.s: The nodal agency for airport development in Andhra Pradesh is:
accepted.x: The nodal agency is Andhra Pradesh Airports Development Corporation Limited (APADCL), formerly BIACL.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct authority and its former name.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT listed as a proposed airport in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Srikakulam, Tuni–Annavaram and Nagarjunasagar are listed among proposed airports. Puttaparthi has a private airstrip of the Sri Sathya Sai Trust and is not listed among the proposed airports.
accepted.tq: Find the place that belongs to a different airport category.

accepted.s: Puttaparthi's aviation facility is best described as:
o: A greenfield international airport under PPP
A domestic airport operated under UDAN
A civil enclave at INS Dega
A private airstrip of the Sri Sathya Sai Trust
accepted.x: Puttaparthi has a private airstrip belonging to the Sri Sathya Sai Trust and is not among Andhra Pradesh's six operational airports.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a private airstrip from scheduled public airports.

accepted.s: Which one of the following airports is identified as the busiest in Andhra Pradesh, with 30.95 lakh passengers in FY 2024–25?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam Airport was the busiest, recording 30.95 lakh passengers in FY 2024–25.
accepted.tq: Match the traffic figure with the airport having the stated rank.

accepted.s: Which airport in Andhra Pradesh has DIGI YATRA and a new terminal costing ₹408.06 crore?
accepted.x: Vijayawada (Gannavaram) Airport has DIGI YATRA and a new terminal costing ₹408.06 crore.
accepted.tq: Link a facility and project cost to the correct airport.

accepted.s: Which airport has a new terminal costing ₹350 crore and a runway of 3,165 metres?
accepted.x: Rajahmundry Airport has a 3,165-metre runway and a new terminal costing ₹350 crore.
accepted.tq: Match two infrastructure specifications to one airport.

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about proposed airports and water aerodromes in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
1. Amaravati is proposed to have an airport spread over 4,500 acres.
2. Seaplane water aerodromes are planned at ten sites, including Prakasam Barrage.
3. Kuppam and Ongole are among the proposed airport locations.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Amaravati is associated with a proposed 4,500-acre airport, and Kuppam, Ongole and Prakasam Barrage are included in the respective plans.
accepted.tq: Test multiple proposed-project details through coded statements.
